response.overview: Pain is something we would do without, if we could. We avoid it, contain it, and hope it will pass. For Federica Bruschi, accustomed to a high threshold for pain, a burn or a broken bone are almost negligible physical discomforts. The car accident that gave rise to Sublimazione, however, introduces a different kind of suffering. Physical, emotional, all-encompassing. An experience that transforms her body and alters her ability to recognize it as her own.
